record.body:
## Description

Fix reviewer NEEDS_WORK: bundled contract must default phase_gate.suite to mode=none; this repo's full+advisory pin must live in the live design (`.artifacts/project-design.json`), with tests that assert both sides from the real JSON files.

## Approach

1. Set `contract/project-design.json` phase_gate.suite to mode=none, command="", gate=required (plugin/bundled default per R2 / suite-plugin-defaults).
2. Set live `.artifacts/project-design.json` (primary + worktree) to mode=full, gate=advisory, README full-suite command (R6); resolve + pin digest on the worktree commit path as appropriate (parent will pin store on primary).
3. Update `tests/test_contract_self_consistency.py`: assert bundled contract JSON is mode=none; assert this-repo live design (or documented pin path) is full+advisory; remove constant-only fake default test.
4. Update `phase-gate-contract-repo` style asserts / any README contradiction so consumer default and this-repo pin are both truthful.
5. Do not weaken red-first or add agent waiver.

payload.title: Separate bundled suite default (none) from this-repo full+advisory pin

record.subject: fix-phase-gate-defaults
